nodes.label: Durable Request Gateway Requirement
nodes.rationale: In-memory guards do not persist across restarts, coordinate multiple EA instances, or connect to a send path, so future requests must use one durable gateway with reconciliation and duplicate-intent suppression.

nodes.label: Fresh Demo capture acceptance
nodes.rationale: Run compiled StrategyChecks manually, then capture a new 5–10 minute run using XAUUSD_o, a fresh filename, independently verified server offset and Tehran offset 12600. Preserve run01; validate and normalize the new file before complete pipeline acceptance.

nodes.label: Numeric candidate serialization fix
nodes.rationale: 252 malformed rows contained unquoted formatted datetime in candidate_server_epoch: 179 BOS_CANDIDATE_BREAK, 71 BOS_CANDIDATE_QUALIFIED, 2 BIG_CANDLE_CONFIRMED. Shared datetime-through-long serialization emits a JSON integer; the Big Candle payload reused by FVG receives the same fix.

nodes.label: Timestamp precision and lifecycle intervals
nodes.rationale: Final tick 05:54:41.864Z and TimeCurrent shutdown 05:54:41.000Z require known whole-second lifecycle observations to represent [second, second+1s). Explicit market fractions, including zero, retain millisecond precision. Legacy handling uses an explicit allowlist; previous-second shutdown and precise regressions still fail.

nodes.label: Planned Core Entry Anchor for Reversal Retests
nodes.norm_label: planned core entry anchor for reversal retests
nodes.rationale: The canonical source correction supersedes the earlier midpoint or edge interpretation: reversals retest the original planned Core/BOS entry; the actual fill does not move that anchor.

nodes.label: tools/publish_events.py: checkpointed stdlib local publisher
nodes.rationale: Documented source relationship only. Tails complete MT5 JSONL rows, POSTs batches of at most 100 rows/200KB, reads separate TRADERLAB_INGEST_KEY, retries byte-equivalent batches, atomically checkpoints acknowledged offsets/last-line hashes and stops on truncation/rewrite. Native capture requires compiled/running EA; paper journals may use --source paper --once.

nodes.label: web/db/schema.sql: documented database schema
nodes.rationale: Documented operator setup runs npm run db:setup or executes this file in Neon SQL Editor. Schema statements use one transaction; no production data is dropped. SQL installation is not yet established by source/build checks.

nodes.label: Short-run browser dataset limits
nodes.rationale: Latest 30 runs, 1000-row download pages, first 20,000 events retained; view explicitly freezes and warns at cap. Journal shows last 500 matching rows; export contains all loaded rows. Longer runs need server aggregation and selectable historical window.

nodes.label: Persian RTL event inspection, chart overlays and replay UI
nodes.norm_label: persian rtl event inspection, chart overlays and replay ui
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted Vazirmatn/IBM Plex Mono; TradingView Lightweight Charts candles; confirmed detections, annotated zones, setup plans, exit reasons and replay by visible event count. Future Big Candle confirmations appear only once confirmation event is visible. Dashboard does not construct missing BOS/OB bounds or infer unknown native UTC.

nodes.label: POST /api/ingest
nodes.rationale: Separate bearer ingest key. PostgreSQL transaction locks run, requires contiguous sequence and refuses changed retries or identity reuse. API cannot place orders; ingest key must not be shared with viewer clients.

nodes.label: Browser-local JSONL import
nodes.rationale: File provenance is unverified. Browser parsing does not upload data to Vercel. Decimal conversion is only for chart display; financial calculation stays in strategy engine.

nodes.label: Neon PostgreSQL provisioning and DATABASE_URL

nodes.label: Event polling and publisher connectivity heartbeats
nodes.norm_label: event polling and publisher connectivity heartbeats
nodes.rationale: Browser polls every 3 seconds with one selected-run loop; hidden tabs pause and source/run changes abort fetches. Publisher heartbeats every 10 seconds separate connectivity from event freshness. Missing ticks do not imply active strategy. EA never waits on an HTTP request.

nodes.label: Durable PostgreSQL event/run storage
nodes.rationale: Retains raw payloads, source timestamps and receipt timestamps; not Vercel function filesystem or request-global memory. Later rows beyond browser cap remain in database. No retention/deletion policy introduced.

nodes.label: Vercel deployment configuration
nodes.rationale: Create/claim project, connect repository, Root Directory web, Next.js framework, npm run build and Node22+. Set independently generated ingest/session secrets >=32 characters and viewer password >=12; none NEXT_PUBLIC_*. Redeploy after environment changes. Failed cloud requests never substitute simulated run.

nodes.label: Protected live API viewer sessions

Login limited to 5 attempts per 15-minute IP-key PostgreSQL bucket; origins checked on session mutations. Logout clears credentials and displayed live state. Public readiness exposes booleans only.

nodes.label: Loss-aware raw TICK metadata
nodes.rationale: Native integers time_msc, broker_time_seconds, one-based full-group millisecond_ordinal, flags and volume; decimal last/volume_real at 16 places, bid/ask/spread at eight places. Source millisecond metadata preserves occurrence multiplicity independently of formatted prices.

nodes.label: Run04 live validation procedure
nodes.rationale: Compile both sources, execute native script requiring failures=0, detach before binary replacement, use LiteFinance Demo/hedging XAUUSD_o. Unique TraderLab-demo-20261007-run04.jsonl; server 10800 only if independently verified, Tehran 12600. Confirm broker_orders_enabled=false and 1000ms start timer; capture 5-10 minutes, cleanly detach, preserve raw, inspect then normalize fresh output. Require zero capture/config errors, valid final envelope and reconciled counters. Native runtime and run04 remain UNVERIFIED.

nodes.label: TICK_CAPTURE_AMBIGUITY
nodes.rationale: Missing, shortened, mutated or reordered prefix, missing head, invalid raw time or regression permanently halt emission and detectors; no fallback quotes or fabricated ticks.

nodes.label: TICK_CAPTURE_SUMMARY
nodes.rationale: Counters reconcile stored ticks: emitted_ticks equals final tick_index and callback_snapshot_matches plus recovered_ticks. Recovery is not proven dropped NewTick count. Final cursor millisecond and boundary count agree with last tick/ordinal; errors or halt invalidate terminal_cursor_evidence_valid.

nodes.label: TickCursorChecks native synthetic assertions
nodes.rationale: StrategyChecks invokes synthetic MqlTick arrays for delayed batches, overlap, identical/distinct same-ms occurrences, identity fields, whole-batch chronology, UTC formatting, startup exclusion and boundary failures. These checks do not exercise live CopyTicks API or timer; native script runtime remains UNVERIFIED.

nodes.label: TLTickCapture
nodes.rationale: One emitter owns callback/timer/deinit history drains and emits raw tick metadata plus start, recovery, error, ambiguity and summary. MT5 serializes EA handlers.

nodes.label: TLTickCursor
nodes.rationale: One cursor retains all ordered raw records in the final millisecond; full-batch validation precedes suffix consumption and failures leave cursor unchanged.

nodes.label: RequestGuard.mqh
nodes.rationale: Isolated in-memory request-rate/idempotency reference with no dispatch method and no connection to TraderLab.mq5.

nodes.label: StrategyChecks.mq5
nodes.rationale: Includes Rules, RequestGuard, EventLog, Detection and TickCapture; checks synthetic cursors, canonical plans and boundaries, OB/BE/daily/request guards and numeric candidate JSON.

nodes.label: TLBarDetector.Process
nodes.rationale: Detection includes Rules and EventLog. Implements BIG-01 delayed 21-bar window, FVG-01/02 geometry and BOS-01 diagnostic candidates.

nodes.label: TLCandidateEpoch
nodes.rationale: Converts datetime through long before serialization to emit numeric candidate_server_epoch for BOS, Big Candle and FVG payloads.

nodes.label: TLCorePlan
nodes.rationale: Rules defines TLCorePlan for SELECT-02/SL-01/TP-01, TLBreakEven for BE-01, TLOBroken for OB10-pip and TLDailyGuard for DAY-01/02.

nodes.label: TLEventLog
nodes.rationale: JSONL escaping, explicit server-to-UTC-to-Tehran conversion, lifecycle seconds versus market millisecond timestamp_precision, and overwrite refusal.

nodes.label: TraderLab.mq5
nodes.rationale: Includes Detection and TickCapture. OnInit opens/writes log and capabilities; OnTick invokes OnCallback without detector scan; each one-second OnTimer drains then scans five closed-bar frames; OnDeinit kills timer, drains, processes bars, writes summary and closes. No broker orders.

nodes.label: Event Schema v0.1
nodes.rationale: JSONL replay requires explicit UTC, chronological ordering and decimal strings. Native raw symbol preserves the broker alias; authored replay annotations use canonical XAUUSD.

nodes.label: First LiteFinance Demo Capture
nodes.rationale: Read-only pipeline procedure; current run04 uses LOSS_AWARE_CAPTURE. MetaEditor build 6244 compilation succeeded on 2026-10-07: TraderLab zero errors and one pre-existing version warning; StrategyChecks zero errors/warnings. Compilation does not establish native execution.

nodes.label: Loss-aware native tick capture
nodes.rationale: Read-only terminal-history capture; run03 established valid JSON and Demo/hedging permissions on XAUUSD_o, not complete delivery. Run04 is the first live implementation validation.

nodes.label: Native source map
nodes.rationale: Documented includes and calls are not native AST extraction: Graphify 0.9.74 does not classify MQL5 extensions. Native broker execution, full paper state machine and Python/MQL5 execution parity remain pending.

nodes.label: Live broker server offset verification
nodes.rationale: Compare several fresh quote server times with synchronized UTC on the same computer before accepting capture. Expected GMT+3 is conditional on observation. Contradictory offset prevents acceptance; never rewrite history. Tehran is separately +03:30.

nodes.label: Unknown upstream broker feed completeness
nodes.rationale: broker_feed_complete always remains null. MT5 has no global broker tick ID; evidence is limited to unchanged ordered terminal-history prefixes. Identical observed prefixes and broker/network omissions cannot be independently distinguished; contiguous emitted indexes prove only stream continuity.

nodes.label: CopyTicksRange inclusive history drain
nodes.rationale: COPY_TICKS_ALL dynamically fetches inclusive cursor-to-head range without default count cap; validates API success, raw seconds/milliseconds, chronology and sampled head presence before emitting. Positive partial timeout results are rejected; errors retain cursor for retry but invalidate run acceptance.

nodes.label: Capture durability and acceptance envelope
nodes.rationale: FileWriteString and FileFlush remain per event; clean deinit writes final ticks, summary and EA_DEINIT before close. Crash may leave incomplete row/no summary; no restart restoration. Stored-row/count reconciliation and JSON integrity are required because counters alone cannot certify storage and FileFlush does not guarantee OS/device durability.

nodes.label: Ordered prefix occurrence deduplication
nodes.rationale: Compares time, time_msc, bid, ask, last, volume, flags and volume_real before formatting. Skips only validated consumed prefix occurrences, preserving both distinct and repeated identical appended records with tick_index and ordinal.

nodes.label: Startup baseline snapshot
nodes.rationale: Requests entire latest sampled head millisecond group and requires the head. Excludes all baseline occurrences and earlier ticks; subsequently appended startup-millisecond occurrences remain eligible. Initialization fails without established baseline.
